$comment: Root ADR-0363. Every provider the platform logs into with an account, and what its owner does when the provider refuses that account. Names only, never values: the credentials' variable names live in config/environment-variable-naming.contract.json (credentials_group). A login client reports a refusal as CollectionError::ProviderAccountActionRequired with this file's provider key and the provider's own result code (foundation-publisher-core provider_outcome); scripts/ops/provider_alert.py reads this file to page the owner action through Alertmanager, and clears the alert on the next login that succeeds. orchestration/tests/test_provider_alert.py refuses a login client whose provider is not here.

vworld.kr.first_seen: 2026-10-30 13:07Z: the login answered result=useChk (이용약관 변경안내); the deploy of 59c0b68 stopped at the staging smoke and every VWorld collection failed until the owner accepted the terms.

alert.hold_reason: Every job that logs in refreshes the alert on each refusal; the daily sweep runs once a day, so 26 hours keeps it firing between two of its runs and lets it lapse a day after nothing logs in any more. A login that succeeds resolves it at once.
